reuse.why: The change extends the shared isWeekendOrHoliday helper, but the two inline holiday checks in server/schedules/app.ts (getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) are neither routed through it nor updated, so the new MM-DD rule only reaches part of the code paths.

duplication.why: The diff itself adds no copied logic, though it leaves the pre-existing duplicated holiday-membership checks in app.ts to diverge from the updated helper.

placement.why: Holiday matching is changed in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree's holiday helper lives.

scope.why: Only the helper and one focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: The matching rule is small and readable, but holiday matching now has two definitions (full-date only in app.ts, full-date or month-day in shared), a trap for the next maintainer; it should be exported and reused there.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff adds no bypassing call; the inline checks in server/schedules/app.ts lines ~526 and ~570 predate it and are left as they were.
